context: Request: all New York-law credit facilities run out of the Banking & Finance practice as facility counsel, excluding warehouse/repo/securitization and real-estate-secured mortgage/construction financings. Rubric: nine qualifying matters (1005-00001, 1006-00001, 1010-00001, 1012-00001, 1019-00002, 1021-00001, 1038-00002, 1042-00001, 1043-00001) with proof documents, plus precision; 1019-00002, 1021-00001 and 1043-00001 are corporate facilities with some real-property collateral or construction use of proceeds.

runs.failure_point: It read the real-estate carve-out broadly and excluded five corporate facilities (one on a review's push), while counting one facility outside the set.

first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The screening review at [103] said one of these matters was written off as a real-estate financing with no document opened; the agent wrote the exclusion without opening it.
first_error.why: The answer excludes four corporate credit facilities as real-estate-secured financings because their collateral packages included mortgages or the proceeds funded construction, reading the carve-out broadly (evidence seen at [33]-[101]).

other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The review at [83] said governing law was not confirmed for this matter among others; it stayed in the answer.
other_errors.why: The answer counts one revolving facility outside the set as a New York-law facility (evidence seen at [33]-[81]).

other_errors.critic_note: The write review at [109] told the agent to move this matter to exclusions if its mortgage was a core security element; the agent did, and the next review at [158] called that a possible over-removal.
other_errors.why: The edit moved a corporate mezzanine facility it had first counted into exclusions because its post-closing obligations included a second-lien mortgage.

runs.failure_point: It excluded two corporate facilities under a broad reading of the real-estate carve-out and counted eight amendment and deal-financing matters.

first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The screening review at [87] said the exclusions of these two matters were claimed with no read; the agent ran an extraction over all candidates and still excluded them.
first_error.why: The answer excludes two corporate credit facilities as real-estate-secured or construction financings, reading the carve-out broadly, after its extraction script showed their executed agreements (evidence seen at [52]-[93]).

other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The write review at [101] asked the agent to reconsider whether the amendment-only matters qualify; it kept them with a note.
other_errors.why: The answer counts eight matters outside the set, including facility amendments filed as separate matters and acquisition-financing commitments in deal matters, as qualifying facilities.

divergence: Mixed (T1 passes; T0 and T2 fail). All three runs scanned the store and screened the facility candidates, so every run opened all nine qualifying matters. They split at the write stage: T1 read the real-estate carve-out narrowly and counted corporate facilities with some real-property collateral or construction use, while T0 (four, later five) and T2 (two) excluded them; T0 and T2 also counted extra matters (one in T0, eight amendment and deal-financing matters in T2). The reviews differed: in T0 the write review told the agent to drop a facility with a post-closing mortgage, which it did; in T2 reviews questioned exclusions and amendment matters without changing them; T1's reviews pushed only on draft status. No label note or new stage played a role in the split.
